- Absence of fever, warmth, or erythema reduces likelihood of native-joint bacterial sepsis but does not exclude DGI

- Await NAAT (urine) and synovial fluid PCR for *Neisseria gonorrhoeae*

- Blood cultures (aerobic/anaerobic)

No evidence to support gout (no crystal analysis, normal uric acid not yet reported), rheumatoid arthritis (no RF/anti-CCP, no symmetric small-joint involvement), or reactive arthritis (no preceding GI/GU infection beyond gonorrhea itself, no HLA-B27 data).
